items.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
items.summary: The left-wing incumbent president had lost the first round to right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

items.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement
items.summary: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
items.summary: Maurene Comey believes she was let go from her job as a federal prosecutor because her father is the former FBI director.

items.title: Anthropic warns of 'catastrophic risk' to humankind ahead of blockbuster share listing
items.summary: The company will be the first true artificial intelligence company to go public as tech firms continue to invest heavily in AI.

items.title: Catholic bishops apologise for 'exploited' Trump meeting
items.summary: Two bishops in images that show them praying with Trump have said they believed the meeting was private.

items.title: US Marine indicted for murder and robbery of woman in Japan
items.summary: Prosecutors have indicted Devin Jacob Ballard for a killing that has caused outrage in Japan, local media reports.
